ac_results.reason: Pinned exact assets/manifest/renderer/fonts refs и проверяемая копия по hash: ingest derives private objectKey server-side (workspaces/{ws}/projects/{proj}/assets/{id}/v1/{sha}) caller injection ignored, mime/size limits per kind, pinManifest with rendererVersion/fontRefs/sourceAssetRefs/manifestHash sha256+verifyManifest tamper false, verifyCopyByHash payload sha checked, hash_mismatch_not_verified.

Retain/delete/restore и consent/rights links не теряют последнюю копию молча: retention policy unknown denied, consent_missing then approved->verified then revoke->blocked, delete last verified denied would_lose_last_verified_copy, forceDelete explicit wouldLoseLastCopy true, restore -> blocked with audit, cross-tenant denied.

Тест повторного монтажа/отсутствующего asset явно показывает available/unavailable: planRemount returns available verified vs unavailable with reasons deleted/state_quarantined/not_found, tenant-isolated (ws-b not_found), objectKey+sha pinned refs exposed, verified vs quarantined/deleted/missing distinguishable.
